Margherita's Daily Special V is a Daily Quest that occurs in Ragunna City, Rinascita, [[{{{nation}}}]].

Steps[]

  1. Taste Lelia's (sweet/salty/spicy) dish
  2. Recommend Lelia to Margherita

Sweet Variant[]

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
Having asked about your preferences, Leila might surprise you with something truly special this time. Visit Margherita's resturant and find out.
Lelia: I've been waiting for you. The dish I made should be just to your liking.
I'm ready
Let's see if your cooking has improved.
Lelia: Umm, before you start, there's something I need to say. This is not to test my skills, but...
But?
Lelia: I want to thank you!
Lelia: Thank you for being there as I learned to cook. If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have come this far.
It's all thanks to your own effort.
Then pay me back with delicious food.
Lelia: Today's dish is—Nuvola Fruit Mille-Feuille.
Each layer of the soft, flaky pastry blends with sweet fruit jam, filling the air with a delightful aroma.
You savor each bite of the mille-feuille.
Lelia: How does it taste? I was a bit heavy-handed with the sugar, so I hope it's not too sweet.
It's just sweet enough. It tastes amazing!
Do you have more? I could eat a whole tray of this.
Lelia: Great! I think I'm finally starting to get the hang of it!
Maybe you should consider becoming a chef here.
Lelia: Me, a chef? I only started as a server not long ago
You have the skill for it.
You have the passion for it.
Lelia: You've always been so supportive. Alright, I'll give it some thought.
Lelia: I want my food to make people smile and deliver joy in every bite.
Then go for it.
Lelia: I will!

Dialogue[]

Quest Description

Lelia: Thank you for being there as I learned to cook. If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have come this far.
It's all thanks to your own effort.
Then pay me back with delicious food.
Lelia: Today's dish is—Ragunna Ratatouille.
Thin slices of roasted vegetables are layered in a tapestry of color.
You savor every bite of the ratatouille.
Lelia: What do you think? This is one of my favorite dishes. The seasoning might be a bit light though.
It's wonderfully fresh and light.
Makes me want to dig in for more.
Lelia: Great! I think I'm finally starting to get the hang of it!
Maybe you should consider becoming a chef here.
Lelia: Me, a chef? I only started as a server not long ago
You have the skill for it.

Lelia: You've always been so supportive. Alright, I'll give it some thought.
Lelia: I want my food to make people smile and deliver joy in every bite.
Then go for it.
Lelia: I will!
(Talk to Margherita)
Talk
Margherita: Hey there, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! Here to see me? I have a feelin' this isn't about food!
I'm here to talk about Leila
Margherita: Oh! Lately, she's been working her tail off to get better at cooking.
Margherita: And she's even been splashing out on all the practice ingredients and spices, bless her heart!
She made real progress. I think it might be time...
Margherita: You're reading my mind! Extra hands in the kitchen? Absolutly!
Margherita: Lelia is still findin' her feet, but she'd crack the simple dishes like an acorn.
So it's settled, then?
Margherita: Only if she can muster up the courage, though!
Margherita: She's got a bumpy, lonely path ahead if she wants to be a true chef.
She will make it.
(Quest Complete)
Lelia: You... recommended me to Ms. Margherita?
Yes, but only if you are up for it.
Lelia: Just the idea of cooking during peak hours gets me so nervous I start to shake.
Lelia: But you taught me not to let opportunities slip by. So if the manager agrees, I'll be there.
